<a id="cpg-cpp03-req-000001"></a>
## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000001: Trigraph replacement precedes line splicing

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** lex\.trigraph\.splice; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #202; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:2\.1:p1.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- Basic\-source characters with a final newline\.

**Exceptions:**

- UCN creation and missing final newlines are outside this card\.

**Rule:**

Replace trigraphs before removing backslash\-newline pairs\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Keep physical source ranges through both transformations\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: Input int ab??/<br>cd; must produce identifier abcd, not ab followed by cd\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000002: Comments preserve token separation

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

Replace each comment with a space rather than concatenating its neighbours\.

**CPG consequence:**

Preserve two tokens across a removed comment\.

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: Input long/\*\*/value; must retain long and value as separate tokens\.

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

<a id="cpg-cpp03-req-000003"></a>
## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000003: Reject unfinished preprocessing tokens and comments

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** lex\.partial\.eof; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #202; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:2\.1:p1.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- Source ends inside a token or block comment\.

**Exceptions:**

- Do not confuse a complete line comment at end of input with an unfinished block comment\.

**Rule:**

A source file must not end with an incomplete preprocessing token or comment\.

**Classification:**

- diagnostic\_required

**CPG consequence:**

Report lexical failure with the physical start location\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: Input int n; /\* unfinished must report an unterminated comment; input "unfinished must report an unterminated literal\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

<a id="cpg-cpp03-req-000004"></a>
## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000004: Block comments do not nest

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** lex\.comment\.nesting; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #202; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:2\.7:p1.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- Block\-comment delimiters outside literals\.

**Exceptions:**

- Line\-comment controls and delimiters inside literals are excluded\.

**Rule:**

The first closing delimiter ends the comment even if another opening delimiter appeared inside it\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Do not maintain a nested block\-comment depth\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: Input a/\*outer /\*inner \*/b must leave tokens a and b\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

<a id="cpg-cpp03-req-000005"></a>
## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000005: Argument prescan stops at argument boundaries

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** cpp\.argument\.prescan; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #203; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:16\.3\.1:p1, cpp03:16\.3\.4:p1.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- Function\-like macro parameter substitution\.

**Exceptions:**

- Parameters stringized or adjacent to token pasting bypass ordinary prescan\.

**Rule:**

Expand an ordinary argument in isolation, then rescan the substituted replacement together with following source tokens\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Separate argument expansion from replacement rescanning\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: With \#define ID\(x\) x and \#define CALL\(\) 23, ID\(CALL\)\(\) must expand to 23; CALL alone must survive prescan\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000006: Stringization preserves raw argument spelling

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** cpp\.stringize\.raw; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #203; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:16\.3\.2:p2.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- One stringized argument producing a valid string literal\.

**Exceptions:**

- Invalid resulting literals and ordering among multiple \#/\#\# operators are excluded\.

**Rule:**

Stringize unexpanded argument spelling, trim boundary whitespace, collapse internal whitespace runs and escape quotes/backslashes within literal tokens\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Retain raw tokens and whitespace for stringization\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: With \#define VALUE 11 and \#define STR\(x\) \#x, STR\( VALUE \+  VALUE \) must produce "VALUE \+ VALUE", not "11 \+ 11"; STR\("q"\) must preserve escaped quotes\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

<a id="cpg-cpp03-req-000007"></a>
## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000007: Active macro names remain unavailable during rescan

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** cpp\.rescan\.disabled; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #203; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:16\.3\.4:p1, cpp03:16\.3\.4:p2.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- A replacement encounters the currently expanding macro, including nested replacements\.

**Exceptions:**

- This restriction does not disable unrelated later source occurrences\.

**Rule:**

Suppress that occurrence and keep it unavailable in later replacement rescans\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Track unavailable tokens rather than using only a recursion depth limit\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: With \#define LOOP\(x\) LOOP\(x\), LOOP\(6\) must terminate as LOOP\(6\); a separate invocation must be processed independently\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

<a id="cpg-cpp03-req-000008"></a>
## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000008: Built\-in AND conditionally evaluates its right operand

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** expr\.and\.shortcircuit; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #348; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:5\.14:p1, cpp03:5\.14:p2.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- Built\-in &amp;&amp; with operands convertible to bool\.

**Exceptions:**

- Temporary destruction is excluded from the side\-effect ordering guarantee; overloaded operators are excluded\.

**Rule:**

Evaluate left first; evaluate right only when left is true\. Complete left\-side effects before starting right\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Represent a conditional right\-hand CFG path and retain executed effects\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: int n=0; bool b=false &amp;&amp; \+\+n; leaves n=0 and b=false\. With n=0, \(\+\+n==1\) &amp;&amp; \(n==1\) yields true and n=1\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

<a id="cpg-cpp03-req-000009"></a>
## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000009: Built\-in OR conditionally evaluates its right operand

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** expr\.or\.shortcircuit; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #348; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:5\.15:p1, cpp03:5\.15:p2.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- Built\-in \|\| with operands convertible to bool\.

**Exceptions:**

- Temporary destruction and overloaded operators are excluded\.

**Rule:**

Evaluate left first; evaluate right only when left is false\. Complete left\-side effects before starting right\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Do not introduce right\-hand effects on the true left\-hand path\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: int n=0; bool b=true \|\| \+\+n; leaves n=0 and b=true\. With n=0, \(\+\+n==0\) \|\| \(n==1\) yields true and n=1\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000010: Sizeof does not evaluate its expression operand

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** expr\.sizeof\.unevaluated; owner #198.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:5\.3\.3:p1.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- A valid sizeof expression with a complete scalar operand type\.

**Exceptions:**

- This does not waive semantic constraints; function types, incomplete types and bit\-fields remain outside this positive case\.

**Rule:**

Determine size without executing the operand expression\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Keep the operand for typing without an executable increment or call\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: int n=8; sizeof\(\+\+n\); leaves n=8\. Do not hard\-code the numeric size of int\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

<a id="cpg-cpp03-req-000011"></a>
## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000011: Destroy members and bases in reverse construction order

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** lifetime\.destruction\.reverse; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #212; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:12\.4:p6.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- Normally completed construction of a class with nonvirtual bases and class\-type members\.

**Exceptions:**

- Partial construction, exceptions, arrays and virtual\-base ownership need separate treatment\.

**Rule:**

After the destructor body and its automatic locals, destroy members and bases in reverse order of completed construction\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Reverse the semantic construction plan, not written initializer order\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: For class C : B with members M first, second, log destructor calls: C body, second, first, B; swapping written member initializer order must not swap destruction\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

<a id="cpg-cpp03-req-000012"></a>
## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000012: Only the most\-derived destructor destroys virtual bases

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** lifetime\.virtualbase\.owner; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #212; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:12\.4:p6.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- Destruction of a completed object with a virtual base\.

**Exceptions:**

- Nonvirtual duplicate bases are distinct subobjects\.

**Rule:**

Destroy virtual bases from the most\-derived destructor, not from intermediate base\-subobject destructor invocations\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Make complete\-object versus base\-subobject destruction context explicit\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Relevant to CPG source semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- example: For V, A : virtual V and D : A, destruction of D must destroy V once, after A, rather than once from A and again from D\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.

## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000013: Class and typename introduce equivalent type parameters

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** template\.typeparam\.spelling; owner #198.

**Status owners:** implementation: #214; readiness: #198; verification: #200.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:14\.1:p2.

Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- An ordinary type\-parameter declaration\.

**Exceptions:**

- Do not generalize this to template\-template parameters or dependent qualified names\.

**Rule:**

## CPG-CPP03-REQ-000061: Recognize function\-like invocation across whitespace

**Reviewed text; consult verification state separately.**

**States:** readiness=reviewed; implementation=partial; verification=not_run.

**Identity:** macro\.function\.invoke; owner #203.

**Status owners:** implementation: #203; readiness: #203; verification: #203.

**Basis:** iso14882\-2003 \(iso2003\); original\_reviewed; cpp03:16\.3:p9.

Original reviewed; macros\.md\.

**Conditions:**

- A function\-like macro name is followed by \( as the next preprocessing token\.

**Exceptions:**

- Without a following opening\-parenthesis token the name is not invoked\.

**Rule:**

Replace through the matching closing parenthesis, skipping matched nested pairs; newlines inside the invocation are ordinary whitespace\.

**Classification:**

- well\_formed

**CPG consequence:**

Keep physical invocation spans across lines\.

**Platform policy:**

C\+\+03; provenance is CPG policy\.

**Dependencies:** None.

**Applicability:** applicable — Preprocessing semantics\.

**Proposed checks (not execution evidence):**

- boundary: For \#define SAME\(t\) t, SAME followed by newline and \(9\) invokes; SAME followed by \+ does not\.

**Actual evidence:**

None recorded; no execution claim.

**Open questions:**

None.
